${s.title}

${s.body}
`).join(''); const html = `
${intro.slice(0, 100)}
${sectionsHtml}
PulseStack Weekly ${draft['Week']}

Hi {{contact.FIRSTNAME}},

${intro}

${cta}

You're receiving this because you subscribed to PulseStack Weekly.
Unsubscribe  ·  Privacy Policy

PulseStack, Inc. · 123 Market Street, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94105

`; const htmlEscaped = html.replace(/\n/g, '').replace(/"/g, '\\"'); return [{ json: { htmlBody: htmlEscaped, listId: segment.Mailchimp_List_ID_Or_Brevo_List_ID, segmentName: segment.Segment_Name } }];
